column1: # TimewarpTV library manifest - read by scripts/build-library.sh.
# Copy this file to scripts/library.tsv (kept out of git: it's your library)
# and replace the example rows with your own.
# One row per source folder:  <channel-folder> TAB <path under the source root>
# Each source folder is copied to <drive>/<channel-folder>/<source folder name>/,
# so several shows can share one channel.
# "SKIP" as the channel keeps a folder off the drive. Every folder directly
# under "TV Shows/" and "Movies/" in the source must appear exactly once - as a
# row or a SKIP - so a newly added show can't be silently left off.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. Columns are TAB-separated.
